desc: a storm-armoured juggernaut walking AWAY from the viewer: the back of a massive humanoid in heavy dark-blue plate armour with pale-blue lightning veins along the plates and a glowing blue core, a smooth rounded helm seen from behind (no face), huge shoulder pauldrons, thick armoured legs and sabatons

desc_v2:
THE CHARACTER (reference 1 -- reproduce this exact figure, its design must not
change): a massive storm-armoured juggernaut seen from BEHIND: heavy GUNMETAL dark-steel plate
(not bright blue) with pale-blue lightning veins crackling along the plates; ENORMOUS layered
shoulder pauldrons exactly as wide as in reference 1 (at the shoulders the silhouette is far wider
than the hips); a rounded spiked helm seen from behind; a BROWN LEATHER tabard hanging from the
belt over the back of the thighs; thick armoured legs and sabatons. The glowing blue lightning
MAW on his chest is on the FRONT ONLY -- from behind the back is plain dark plate: draw NO glowing
orb, core, gem, light or opening anywhere on the back.
